question: For whom is vision said to occur from afar in relation to that circle?
premises: Vision is said to occur from afar.
This occurs in relation to that circle.
It belongs to one devoted to worship and meditation.
inference: For one devoted to worship and meditation, vision arises from afar in relation to that circle.
uncertainties: The nature of that vision is not specified.
plain_english: And indeed, for one devoted to worship and meditation, vision occurs from afar in that circle.
